issues.legal_issue: A writ petition under Article 226 is not maintainable to challenge a bank’s SARFAESI auction notice when an alternative statutory remedy is available under Section 17 of the SARFAESI Act.

A person holding only an agreement to sell, where the transaction was entered into without the required approval and was declared void, cannot rely on that transaction to challenge the secured creditor’s auction or claim the benefit of Section 13(8) of the SARFAESI Act.
A writ petition challenging an auction notice after the auction has already been conducted is unsustainable where the court grants no consequential relief.
